l.i: Illa eadem Verbo, Flatuq; reguntur louæ.
Omnibus hæc ergo prima & siet vnica cura
Debita diuinæ vt dicat præconia MENTI.

page.notes: The engraving shows a sphere covered with human faces under clouds and rays, with a triangle containing Hebrew letters (the divine name) and an hourglass hanging from it. Catchword "A PRIN-" is set at the lower right. The verse is printed in italic with long s rendered as s; the word "Flatuq;" and the final "MENTI" in capitals are as printed. The running head "EMBLEMA" is printed in spaced capitals, and the title "EX VNO OMNIA." is in large italic capitals.
